create_volumes_from_tensor: create a Volumes object from a 5D density tensor with optional features and voxel size
create_volumes_from_list: create a Volumes object from a list of 4D density tensors with varying spatial sizes
convert_world_to_local_coords: convert 3D world coordinates to local volume coordinates using the Volumes world_to_local_coords method
convert_local_to_world_coords: convert 3D local volume coordinates to world coordinates using the Volumes local_to_world_coords method
get_volume_coord_grid: get the 3D coordinate grid of a volume in local or world coordinates using get_coord_grid
